title: Changed when plugins set up their initial state: `columnSorting`, `columnSummary`, `mergeCells`, `customBorders`, `pagination`, `emptyDataState`, `nestedRows` and `dataProvider` now apply their settings before the first render, so the grid renders once at init and columns under nested headers get their final width at once. Calling `enablePlugin()` on a running grid now applies the plugin's settings.
